intentional_exclusions.control: A model tool never accepts an authentication secret or returns a newly issued one.
Purge planning requires current-password step-up, which bearer MCP cannot prove.
High-impact approval requires a fresh human proof bound to the inspected checksum.
Maker-checker votes require an independent stepped-up human session.
Package admission and permission grants require supply-chain and operator controls.
